title: Qwen 3.8-Flash-Next releasing tomorrow (125B a6B)
summary: Qwen is releasing a new model, Qwen 3.8-Flash-Next, a 125B parameter model with 6B active parameters (MoE), optimized for efficiency and performance. The announcement on ModelScope and Hacker News highlights its upcoming availability, likely targeting deployment in resource-constrained environments while maintaining high capability.
